ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: As shown in the figure, under atmospheric pressure, moist air with an initial air temperature of $30^\circ\mathrm{C}$ and a wet-bulb temperature of $28^\circ\mathrm{C}$ is cooled to saturated air at $10^\circ\mathrm{C}$ after fully contacting a large amount of cold water in a spray chamber. planner_metadata.image_role: Read the process layout from the diagram: moist air enters a spray/water-contact chamber from the left, leaves the chamber at the point labeled 10°C, then passes through a reheater/heat exchanger and exits at the point labeled 30°C. planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text to confirm normal pressure, the chamber outlet is 10°C saturated air, and the final dry-bulb temperature after reheating is 30°C. The initial 30°C dry-bulb and 28°C wet-bulb data are not needed once the outlet state is explicitly given.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: At 1 atm, saturated air at 10°C has humidity ratio equal to the saturation humidity ratio at 10°C. Sensible reheating occurs at constant humidity ratio, so on a psychrometric chart it is a horizontal move from the 10°C saturated point to the 30°C dry-bulb vertical line. The wet-bulb temperature is then read from the wet-bulb lines at that final state.

method.method_draft: Compute the humidity ratio of saturated air at 10°C using saturation vapor pressure at 10°C and P = 101.325 kPa. Keep this same humidity ratio for the reheated air at dry-bulb temperature 30°C. Then calculate the final air enthalpy and solve the wet-bulb balance equation using steam-table or saturation-pressure values until the wet-bulb temperature satisfies the equation; the numerical root is about 18.1°C.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中湿空气从左侧进入，入口旁标有干球温度 t 和湿球温度 t_w；随后进入一个带喷淋水示意的淋水室，离开淋水室后的气流标为 10°C；之后气流通过一个加热器符号，最终出口标为 30°C。因此图示过程是：湿空气经淋水室冷却到 10°C 饱和状态，再在不加湿的情况下被再热到 30°C。

按指定方法计算：常压取 P=101.325 kPa。离开淋水室时为空气在 10°C 下的饱和状态，查饱和水蒸气压 p_ws(10°C)≈1.228 kPa，则其含湿量为
W=0.622 p_ws/(P-p_ws)=0.622×1.228/(101.325-1.228)≈0.00763 kg/kg干空气。
再热到 30°C 时只升温、不增湿，所以含湿量仍为 W≈0.00763 kg/kg干空气。

再热后湿空气焓为
h=1.005×30+W(2500+1.88×30)≈49.6 kJ/kg干空气。
令所求湿球温度为 t_w，对应饱和含湿量 W_s(t_w)=0.622 p_ws(t_w)/(P-p_ws(t_w))。用湿球热量衡算式
h=1.005 t_w+W_s(t_w)(2500+1.88 t_w)-[W_s(t_w)-W]4.186 t_w，
结合饱和水蒸气压表迭代求根。代入 W≈0.00763 和 h≈49.6 kJ/kg干空气，查表/插值得到 t_w 约为 18.1°C。
